tree.heading: Eligibility.—
tree.text: Except as provided in this chapter, eligibility for membership in the corporation and the rights and privileges of members are as provided in constitution and bylaws of the corporation.

tree.heading: Voting.—
tree.text: Each member has one vote in the conduct of official business of the corporation.
